Task:
Echo's RFC 9457 error handler mutates a caller-owned `*ProblemError` while applying default status, type, and title. A package-level sentinel reused across requests is therefore permanently changed and can race. Apply defaults only to response-local state, leaving the original problem unchanged. Preserve explicit fields, exposed-detail behavior, response content type, JSON output, and HEAD/no-content status handling. Add focused regression coverage that reuses the same sentinel.

diff --git a/rfc9457_test.go b/rfc9457_test.go
index 5902e11bf1d2f3958505600d29cc45ee6e1d4ede..dcddd2a501b8f0dbadbc2a93e35d30020c7af0f9
--- a/rfc9457_test.go
+++ b/rfc9457_test.go
@@ -157,6 +157,24 @@
 	}
 }
 
+func TestProblemDetailsHTTPErrorHandler_DoesNotMutateSharedProblem(t *testing.T) {
+	sentinel := &ProblemError{}
+	errHandler := ProblemDetailsHTTPErrorHandler(false)
+
+	for range 2 {
+		e := New()
+		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/", nil)
+		resp := httptest.NewRecorder()
+		c := e.NewContext(req, resp)
+
+		errHandler(c, sentinel)
+
+		assert.Equal(t, http.StatusInternalServerError, resp.Code)
+		assert.Equal(t, `{"type":"about:blank","title":"Internal Server Error","status":500}`+"\n", resp.Body.String())
+		assert.Equal(t, &ProblemError{}, sentinel)
+	}
+}
+
 func TestProblemDetailsHTTPErrorHandler_CommittedResponse(t *testing.T) {
 	e := New()
 	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/", nil)
